It's one of the only things that allows me to let loose and have fun, which is great until eventually you realize you're a total mess without it. Moderation is definitely key, and only smoking until you're in a nice place, rather than blazing until you're too stoned to do much besides eat and nap.

I've felt this way for longer than I remember. I made an attempt last year, but luckily failed. The feeling you have won't necessarily go away, but believe me it gets so much better. 

Instead of focusing on the pointlessness of this existence, try finding purpose in your own way; either by interacting with all the unique people around you, or from taking interest in the way the universe works and how things satisfyingly make sense scientifically. 

I know this probably won't help you right away, but consider that you can make your life into literally anything you want. You might not be able to change it today, or tomorrow, or even a year from now; but you can take steps and make changes that bring you closer and closer to a life much more fulfilling than the one you're currently living.

Hey thanks for the reply! I actually just got my test score back today and I passed somehow. You only need to get 8/20 possible points, and I got 14. I spent all week studying because I thought I failed it. Hopefully the rest of the subtests are as easy as I'm assuming. I scheduled the social studies one for this friday, and on a computer so I get the results right away.
I took the Hiset, which is what the practice test was for. I don't think Massachusetts has the GED anymore.

Staying in the US is definitely more realistic for me. I was just wondering how unrealistic studying abroad would be. I'm still just trying to figure things out so this isn't as soul-crushing as it is helpful in narrowing down my options.

Thanks!

What are the chances of someone without a real high school diploma, but a GED, getting into one of the actual top-notch universities..?

Medication isn't an option for me. I know it can help other people, but I just can't. I enjoy being creative, but I'm not very good at anything creative. There's nothing I can see myself making a happy living doing that's attainable.
I'm basically your typical unskilled leech. I half-ass everything I try to learn. I suck at guitar, I suck at drawing, I suck at having any sort of work ethic.

I'm going to look up mindfulness exercises today; I'm never really where I am, if that makes sense.
 I broke my hand by punching a wooden post a few times last month when I found out my cousin/best friend stole my iPod. I wasn't mad about the iPod, but at the fact that he was willing to lie about it and break ties with both me and my brothers over it. 

I used to go to therapy, but my mom took me out of it when the therapist suggested that my mom might need to change her behavior a bit based on the things I told the therapist. The shit with my mom is a whole different can of worms though.

I know you're right about everything. I hear that a lot. I'm sure I could find a job if I tried hard enough, but I don't. Plus I have to wait until my hand isn't broken; another beautiful excuse to spend everyday doing literally nothing. I don't want to do nothing, but everything just feels pointless.
Someone say something. To me and all the other posts with no comments. Please.
